Comment: AWS EventBridge rule for daily recurring order generation. Deploy via AWS CLI or CloudFormation.

Rule.Name: DailyRecurringOrderGeneration
Rule.Description: Triggers Lambda at 6:00 AM EST daily to generate recurring delivery orders

DeployCLI.step1_create_rule: aws events put-rule --name DailyRecurringOrderGeneration --schedule-expression 'cron(0 11 * * ? *)' --description 'Daily recurring order generation at 6 AM EST'
DeployCLI.step3_add_permission: aws lambda add-permission --function-name generate-recurring-orders --statement-id EventBridgeInvoke --action lambda:InvokeFunction --principal events.amazonaws.com --source-arn arn:aws:events:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:rule/DailyRecurringOrderGeneration
